verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs repeatedly describe AI Gateway as a way to call hundreds of models through one endpoint. That endpoint works with the AI SDK, OpenAI-compatible SDKs, or cURL, and adds cross-provider routing, fallbacks, budgets, and monitoring. This directly matches the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and a documented model/provider catalog substantiating the 'hundreds' claim beyond summary-level docs.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
